description:
`benchmarks/<name>.toml` or `.yaml`: the cases a comparison replays and the scorers that grade
them. The file name is the benchmark's name.

cases.description: The case folders, each relative to the benchmark file's folder.

description.description: What the cases are, in one line.

primary.description: The scorer whose verdict the comparison gives: one that reads `result` or `diff`.

scorers.description: Other scorers, shown beside the primary one with no verdict.

title: benchmark
